package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

type custom string

func (c custom) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(`{"custom":"wire"}`), nil
}

var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(func() {
			Attribute("opaque", Any, func() {
				Example(custom("source"))
			})
			Required("opaque")
		})
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/send")
		})

	})

})
